query:
-- Check for any day_3 rows created after the blast (tonight)
SELECT touchKey, status, COUNT(*) as cnt, MIN(scheduledFor) as earliest, MAX(scheduledFor) as latest
FROM leadSequenceQueue
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND touchKey IN ('day_3_spots_filling', 'day_6_last_call')
  AND createdAt > '2026-06-09 19:00:00'
GROUP BY touchKey, status;

-- Also check day_0 rows created tonight to confirm blast count
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM leadSequenceQueue
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND touchKey = 'day_0_camp_overview'
  AND createdAt > '2026-06-09 19:00:00'
GROUP BY status;
